title: Market Rickshaw Rush
shortDescription: Dodge obstacles and collect tokens in a colourful offline rickshaw runner.
fullDescription:
Your lane. Your rhythm.

Steer an original auto-rickshaw through a colourful fictional Indian market. Change between three lanes, avoid crates, potholes, delivery carts, parked vehicles and clearly marked animal obstacles, and collect gold delivery tokens.

Choose Easy, Normal or Hard. Speed increases gradually to a cap. Each seeded route includes a planned safe corridor, but you need to steer in time. Distance and tokens build your score; one collision ends the run.

Use swipes or on-screen arrow buttons. Pause whenever you need; resuming uses a three-second countdown. Replay immediately and keep your best score for each difficulty.

Explore Golden Bazaar, Coastal Market and Monsoon Street: three visual settings with the same fair lane rules. Choose everyday, kite or festival-light decorations and optional evening lighting. Unlock decorated indigo and coral rickshaw paint at 300 and 800 best points.

Original illustrated stalls, vendors, shoppers, animals and circus scenery, English/Hindi menus, a tutorial, saved local scores and reduced effects are bundled offline. Original synthesized instrumental music, quiet ambience and game sounds have independent music/sound controls.

No account, cloud sync, ads or purchases. This is a fictional arcade game, not a real road map or driving lesson. Look out for new routes in future app updates.
